name: Astralynx
description: The transcendent guardian of the Nebulynx family. Six sure-footed paws cross the night sky beneath a sweeping aurora mane, while twin comet tails gather lost wishes into a shelter of stars.

name: Solcanis
description: The transcendent guardian of the Volcanip family. Nine sun-bright tails surround an obsidian body veined with golden magma. Its mighty volcanic crown keeps a gentle, everlasting warmth for every friend beneath it.

name: Eversylva
description: The transcendent guardian of the Florafae family. All four seasons bloom in its living antlers, and six luminous leaf wings shelter a forest of small lives. Wherever it rests, a sanctuary takes root.

name: Aeternabbit
description: The transcendent guardian of the Chronibun family. Starlit sands drift through its hourglass ears while golden gear fans unfold around a sunrise heart. In its gentle company, every hurried moment finds time to breathe.

name: Oceanthrone
description: The transcendent guardian of the Tiderune family. Six webbed paws cross silent seas beneath a pearl-and-coral crown. Vast galaxy fins hold the ocean's forgotten wishes, and its gentle wake guides small travelers safely home.

name: Prismarch
description: The transcendent guardian of the Mirrormite family. Its opal shell unfolds into four magnificent prism wings, scattering gentle rainbow paths around six jeweled legs. A shelter of refracted light welcomes every wandering friend.

name: Tempestaur
description: The transcendent guardian of the Stormlet family. Four lightning-bright wings shelter a calm heart at the center of every storm. Its cloud-soft paws and golden tail feathers lead tired travelers into a pocket of peaceful sky.

name: Reverion
description: The transcendent guardian of the Dreamip family. Six constellation ribbons unfurl as wings beneath a crescent crown, and twin silken tails weave safe paths through sleep. Its quiet presence turns restless dreams into welcoming worlds.

name: Verdantheon
description: A godly forest sovereign with six branching tree-antlers and emerald wings. Verdantheon raises one hoof to call a living canopy into being, giving every small Sipling a safe place to grow.

name: Cindervalkyr
description: A radiant phoenix-salamander deity whose asymmetric flame wings carve a path through the sky. Cindervalkyr dives through sparks and returns brighter, warming every cup and courageous heart below.

name: Noctyra
description: A moon-moth oracle with four crescent wings and a silver lunar halo. Noctyra spirals through the night, turning anxious dreams into quiet constellations and gentle guidance.

name: Galaxion
description: A celestial koi-serpent that loops through the air like a river of stars. Its comet fins and orbiting planet carry wishes between worlds, guiding every lost traveler home.

name: Lattepoltergeist
description: The crazy fourth form of the Foamlet family: a godly cappuccino ghost cyclone erupting from a cracked espresso cup. Its orbiting saucers, crooked cinnamon antlers, and wild crema ribbons turn every quiet caf? into a joyful storm.
